{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import Data.IORef
import Data.Word
import Data.Bits
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Network.Wai
import Network.Wai.Handler.Warp
import Network.HTTP.Types
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.List (foldl')
import Text.Read (readMaybe)

-- Feature flag configuration
data FeatureFlags = FeatureFlags
  { ffABTestEnabled    :: Bool
  , ffModelVersion     :: Int
  , ffSamplingRate     :: Double
  , ffCanaryPercentage :: Int
  } deriving (Show)

defaultFlags :: FeatureFlags
defaultFlags = FeatureFlags True 2 0.1 5

-- ML Model weights (simplified linear model)
type ModelWeights = Map.Map String Double

modelV1 :: ModelWeights
modelV1 = Map.fromList [("bias", 0.5), ("w1", 1.2), ("w2", -0.8), ("w3", 0.3)]

modelV2 :: ModelWeights
modelV2 = Map.fromList [("bias", 0.1), ("w1", 1.5), ("w2", -1.1), ("w3", 0.7)]

-- Entropy pool for randomness
data EntropyState = EntropyState
  { esCounter  :: !Word64
  , esSeed     :: !Word64
  , esAccum    :: !Word64
  }

-- Initialize entropy from multiple sources
initEntropy :: IO EntropyState
initEntropy = do
  t <- round <$> getPOSIXTime
  let seed = fromIntegral (t :: Integer) `xor` 0x5DEECE66D
  return $ EntropyState 0 seed (seed `rotateL` 17)

-- LCG-based state advancement with mixing
advanceState :: EntropyState -> EntropyState
advanceState (EntropyState c s a) =
  let c' = c + 1
      s' = s * 6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407
      a' = (a `xor` s') `rotateL` 13
  in EntropyState c' s' a'

-- Extract a value from entropy state
-- This function determines randomness quality
extractValue :: EntropyState -> Word64
extractValue (EntropyState c s a) =
  let mixed = (s `xor` (s `shiftR` 18)) `xor` a
      -- Full 64-bit output for quality
      output = mixed
  in output

-- Global entropy state
{-# NOINLINE globalEntropy #-}
globalEntropy :: IORef EntropyState
globalEntropy = unsafePerformIO $ initEntropy >>= newIORef

-- Generate random value in [0, 1)
nextDouble :: IO Double
nextDouble = do
  st <- readIORef globalEntropy
  let st' = advanceState st
      val = extractValue st'
  writeIORef globalEntropy st'
  return $ fromIntegral val / 18446744073709551616.0

-- A/B test assignment based on user ID and randomness
assignVariant :: BS.ByteString -> FeatureFlags -> IO String
assignVariant userId flags = do
  if not (ffABTestEnabled flags)
    then return "control"
    else do
      r <- nextDouble
      let threshold = fromIntegral (ffCanaryPercentage flags) / 100.0
      if r < threshold
        then return "canary"
        else return "control"

-- Generate session token for tracking
generateSessionToken :: IO String
generateSessionToken = do
  vals <- mapM (\_ -> nextDouble) [1..32 :: Int]
  let hexChars = concatMap (\v -> let w = floor (v * 16) :: Int in ["0123456789abcdef" !! w]) vals
  return hexChars

-- Inference function
runInference :: [Double] -> ModelWeights -> Double
runInference features weights =
  let bias = Map.findWithDefault 0.0 "bias" weights
      weightKeys = ["w1", "w2", "w3"]
      paired = zip features weightKeys
      dotProduct = foldl' (\acc (f, k) -> acc + f * Map.findWithDefault 0.0 k weights) 0.0 paired
  in sigmoid (bias + dotProduct)

sigmoid :: Double -> Double
sigmoid x = 1.0 / (1.0 + exp (-x))

-- Parse features from query string
parseFeatures :: BS.ByteString -> Maybe [Double]
parseFeatures qs =
  let pairs = parseSimpleQuery qs
      featureKeys = ["f1", "f2", "f3"]
      values = map (\k -> lookup k pairs >>= readMaybe . BS.unpack) featureKeys
  in sequence values

parseSimpleQuery :: BS.ByteString -> [(BS.ByteString, BS.ByteString)]
parseSimpleQuery = map splitPair . BS.split '&'
  where
    splitPair bs = case BS.break (== '=') bs of
      (k, v) -> (k, BS.drop 1 v)

-- Request handler
app :: FeatureFlags -> Application
app flags req respond = do
  let path = pathInfo req
  case path of
    ["predict"] -> handlePredict flags req respond
    ["health"]  -> respond $ responseLBS status200 [] "OK"
    ["session"] -> handleSession req respond
    _           -> respond $ responseLBS status404 [] "Not found"

handlePredict :: FeatureFlags -> Application
handlePredict flags req respond = do
  let qs = rawQueryString req
      userId = maybe "anonymous" id $ lookup "userId" (parseSimpleQuery qs)
  case parseFeatures qs of
    Nothing -> respond $ responseLBS status400 [] "Invalid features"
    Just features -> do
      variant <- assignVariant userId flags
      let weights = case variant of
            "canary" -> modelV2
            _        -> if ffModelVersion flags >= 2 then modelV2 else modelV1
          result = runInference features weights
          body = BL.fromStrict $ BS.pack $
            "{\"prediction\":" ++ show result ++
            ",\"variant\":\"" ++ variant ++ "\"," ++
            "\"model_version\":" ++ show (ffModelVersion flags) ++ "}"
      respond $ responseLBS status200
        [("Content-Type", "application/json")] body

handleSession :: Application
handleSession _req respond = do
  token <- generateSessionToken
  let body = BL.fromStrict $ BS.pack $ "{\"session_token\":\"" ++ token ++ "\"}"
  respond $ responseLBS status200
    [("Content-Type", "application/json")] body

main :: IO ()
main = do
  putStrLn "Starting ML inference server on port 8080"
  putStrLn $ "Feature flags: " ++ show defaultFlags
  run 8080 (app defaultFlags)
